QUOTE: "`LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`src/inference/llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788`) returns `{}` when `tokenizer_` is unset, and otherwise copies the vector through." and "returns `{}`" on tokenization failure
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the failed tokenization yields `{}` and that the backend wrapper also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It then says an empty vector can't be told apart from empty input, so the two cases return the same value.
